customCSS: [class*='card'], .room-card { transition: transform 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.22s ease; } [class*='card']:hover, .room-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.09); } nav a { position: relative; } nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -3px; left: 0; width: 0; height: 1.5px; background: #7c3aed; transition: width 0.25s ease; } nav a:hover::after { width: 100%; } ::selection { background: #7c3aed22; color: #1e293b; }
